findings.description: The real typed TradingService/TradingCoordinator library composes E5-bound canonical plans, E4 preparations/provider effects and E6 claims/recovery, but no formal production construction/caller or E2-driven TradingService runner was found in the enumerated src/tools Python scope. The explicit normal E2-to-E5-to-submit loop is PaperEngine using PaperBroker; it cannot by itself demonstrate the LIVE-capable TradingService orchestration required by inherited H01.
evidence: TradingService.execute:134-163 consumes an already-issued E4 preparation, validates the current canonical subject, commits the claim and sends through the guarded provider. It does not invoke StrategyRuntime.
TradingCoordinator:7-46 is substantive journal/outbox coordination, not an E2 strategy driver. Its only production construction found is TradingService._coordinator:124-125.

LocalOwners.control_services:93-117 composes Paper ports; PaperOwnerComposition:167-170 constructs PaperService. No TradingService constructor/import appeared outside its own package in the targeted namespace follow-up.
PaperEngine._evaluate:315-367 directly invokes StrategyRuntime, actual risk evaluation/approved-plan construction and ExecutionGateway/PaperBroker.
ShadowComposition:283-321,432-481 also uses E2/E5 with read-only E4, but expressly has no submit gateway or authoritative trading outputs. Research/backtest E2 consumers are separate.
findings.minimal_followup: Complete the formal trusted E2-driven trading runner/composition using the existing actual E2 runtime, E5 risk/plan/action owners, E4 translator and TradingService with current issuer/runtime gates. Add a formal-entry credential-free fake-provider integration proving the exact signal→E5 approval→issued E4 preparation→durable claim→readback chain and denials. No real-provider activation or new financial permission is required to implement/test that glue.
findings.authority_interpretation: Ordinary implementation/integration work under the existing plan, not a new PM/financial-authority blocker. Existing normal Paper qualification and source-owner tests remain distinct and are not invalidated or transferred.
